hook_points.name: per-step loss (normal path)
hook_points.location: train.py:376-377, inside `for step in range(steps)` in train_and_evaluate (loop starts line 278)
hook_points.detail: loss tensor is finite and final at line 370 (after opt.step()); non-invasive hook: wrap/replace the `if step % 500 == 0: print(...)` block, or tee stdout — the printed line '  step {N} loss {X.XXX} [{S}s]' is regex-parseable: r'^\s+step (\d+) loss ([\d.]+) \[(\d+)s\]$'. Note float(loss) syncs the GPU; logging every step adds overhead — log the same 500-step cadence or use loss.detach() and flush periodically.

hook_points.name: per-step loss (sparse_hash path)
hook_points.location: train.py:332-333, same loop, sparse branch ends with `continue` at line 334
hook_points.detail: duplicate print site; any per-step logger must cover both branches or parse stdout (stdout parsing covers both with one regex).

hook_points.name: budget/step accounting
hook_points.location: train.py:281-282 (budget break, sets steps_done) and train.py:384 (`trained {steps_done} steps in {secs}s`)
hook_points.detail: parse r'^trained (\d+) steps in (\d+)s$' for actual steps completed vs configured.

hook_points.name: quick transfer eval
hook_points.detail: scores dict {target: accuracy-or-cosine}; hook by wrapping evaluate() or parsing the line r'^held-out regions \(conditioning on .*\): (.*)$' with ' | '-separated 'name value' pairs. This is the only 'epoch-like' eval — there are no epochs and NO periodic mid-training eval; all evaluation happens once, after training.

hook_points.name: benchmark suite (final scores)
hook_points.location: train.py:412-417; evaluate.evaluate_benchmarks at autoresearch/evaluate.py:112 returns raw Dict[str,float]
hook_points.detail: cleanest programmatic hook: instead of parsing, import and call `ev.evaluate_benchmarks` yourself, or wrap train_and_evaluate; `raw` holds every benchmark's raw score, `ev.normalized(raw)` (evaluate.py:474) the [0,1] scores, `ev.net_score(raw)` (evaluate.py:512) and `ev.arithmetic_net(raw)` (evaluate.py:524) the means. Stdout alternative: parse format_benchmarks table rows r'^  (\S+)\s+([\d.-]+)$' plus r'NET SCORE.*: ([\d.]+)' and r'\(arithmetic mean: ([\d.]+)\)'.

hook_points.name: final parseable footer
hook_points.detail: lines 'tag:              {tag}', 'net_score:        {f:.6f}', 'peak_vram_mb:     {f:.1f}' — designed for grep; a stdout-tee run-logger gets tag+net_score+vram for free.

hook_points.name: zero-code-change wrapper (recommended non-invasive design)
hook_points.location: wrap main(): `from deepearth.autoresearch.train import train_and_evaluate` — or simply run the CLI with `... 2>&1 | tee run.log` and parse
hook_points.detail: train.py already prints everything with flush=True in stable formats; the established convention (autoresearch.md loop step 4) is to capture stdout to run.log and grep it. train_and_evaluate(config_dict, device) also returns (model, scores) with scores['net_score'] for a python-level wrapper without touching train.py.

commands: python autoresearch/train.py                      # config arg optional; defaults to autoresearch/deepcal.yaml
python -m deepearth.autoresearch.train            # module form used by autoresearch.md loop step 3
python autoresearch/train.py autoresearch/deepcal.yaml --device cuda --steps 2291 --tag EXP_ID 2>&1 | tee run.log   # standard experiment run
python autoresearch/train.py autoresearch/deepcal.yaml --eval_ckpt data/deepcal/ckpt_EXP_ID.pt   # eval-only: score an existing checkpoint, skip training
python autoresearch/train.py autoresearch/deepcal.yaml --time_budget 3600 --tag EXP_ID           # wall-clock-capped run
python autoresearch/train.py autoresearch/champion.yaml --save                                    # champion run, writes autoresearch/champion.pt

cli_flags.--cache_dir: override data.cache_dir (relative paths resolved against repo root)
cli_flags.--eval_ckpt: load state_dict, set steps=0, score only
cli_flags.--tag: run label; names ckpt_{tag}.pt and prints 'tag:' footer line
cli_flags.--save: save final state_dict to <config>.pt (champion runs only)

duration.steps: deepcal.yaml/champion.yaml set training.steps: 2291 (fixed step budget; autoresearch.md: complete the fixed steps for comparable runs)
duration.time_budget_s: optional training.time_budget_s or --time_budget; timer starts at step 10 (warmup/compile excluded, train.py:279-282); when hit, prints '[time budget Ns reached at step S]' and breaks; steps_done records actual steps
duration.step_print_cadence: loss every 500 steps with cumulative seconds — wall-time per step derivable from consecutive lines
duration.eval_time: benchmark suite duration printed as 'benchmark_suite_seconds: N.N'
duration.checkpoint_cadence: periodic ckpt every 2000 steps + always one pre-eval ckpt
duration.champion_reference: champion_scores.json records steps: (see file) and steps_completed + parameters (25.4M) + peak_vram_mb for the current record run

config_keys.meaning: run label printed in startup line
variables given during quick transfer eval
list: name, kind(continuous/categorical), classes, num_classes, reconstruct, neighbor, expand:trait_classes
loss on final or all rounds
species GNN: variable, layers, heads, top_k, flex, operator(ou-attention/tree/latent-clade), masked_posterior, bioclip_init
occupancy expert heads, separate optimizer (needs compile:false)
niche prior from train coord/AE stats

champion_scores.json.schema: top-level keys: label (free-text description incl. commit), config (yaml path), protocol, harmonic (float), arithmetic (float), seeds (list), steps, steps_completed, parameters, peak_vram_mb, scores (dict benchmark_name -> float, e.g. 'B1_species_from_env_top10': 0.4032)
champion_scores.json.role: the current record run's full benchmark vector; new candidates compare per-benchmark against it (rule: no individual metric may regress)
champion_scores.json.not_written_by_train.py: train.py never writes it; it is curated (see champion_report.py / CHAMPION_REPORT.md)

results.tsv.convention: autoresearch.md loop: step 1 'Read results.tsv + the per-benchmark profile', step 5 'Append to results.tsv. Keep the commit if the mean rose with no metric regressed; else revert.' Append one row per experiment.
results.tsv.status: file does not currently exist anywhere in the repo (find returned nothing) — it is a convention the researcher creates/maintains manually, not an output of train.py; no column schema is defined in autoresearch.md

run.log.convention: autoresearch.md loop step 4: capture train stdout to run.log; `grep "^net_score:" run.log` — empty means the run crashed (then `tail -50`); the 'tag:' line makes the log self-identifying

selection_rules.north_star: net_score = harmonic mean of ALL active benchmarks (evaluate.py:512), each in [0,1]; diagnostics (*_gain B24,B56-B60) logistic-renormalized in
selection_rules.operator_authorized: MAY select on the ARITHMETIC mean (2026-07-15) since harmonic is dominated by near-zero community-recall variance; report BOTH; no individual metric may regress
selection_rules.comparability: fixed seed (1337) gives matched-init A/B; comparable research runs complete the fixed training.steps (2291) and omit time_budget_s
